evidence.title: David Vélez and Robin Vince join the boards of the OpenAI Foundation and OpenAI Group PBC

summary: OpenAI has appointed David Vélez and Robin Vince to the boards of its Foundation and OpenAI Group PBC. The move expands leadership as the organization scales its AI initiatives.
title: OpenAI Adds David Vélez and Robin Vince to Foundation and Group PBC Boards
